answer: Proof-of-personhood via hardware security keys: each human binds one key at a physical ceremony; the credential signs epoch attestations. An attacker needs one key per fake identity plus travel to each ceremony site, costing ~$50 per key plus logistics. The ridge separating honest users from bots is the biometric check; the grove of valid keys grows slowly, and a violet flag marks any key reused across ceremonies. Defeating it costs linearly in fake identities.
